entity_types.label: Subject
entity_types.definition: A problem, challenge, or field that is the focus of study or problem-solving.

entity_types.label: Theory
entity_types.definition: Principles or theories that describe, explain, or predict particular phenomena.

entity_types.label: Criteria
entity_types.definition: Standards or indicators used to evaluate and judge quality.

entity_types.label: Policy
entity_types.definition: Principles, rules, or guidelines that direct decisions and actions.

entity_types.label: Material
entity_types.definition: A physical or chemical substance or compound with defined properties, used in processes or in producing products.

entity_types.label: Physical_Tools
entity_types.definition: Tools and systems of a material nature used to carry out specialized activities.

entity_types.label: Non_Physical_Tools
entity_types.definition: Non-material tools and systems (e.g., software) used to carry out specialized activities.

entity_types.label: Data
entity_types.definition: Datasets defined for a specific task.

entity_types.label: Process
entity_types.definition: A structured sequence of steps aimed at achieving a specific goal or producing a particular output.

entity_types.label: Method
entity_types.definition: A systematic approach or technique for analysis, problem-solving, or achieving a goal.

entity_types.label: Parameter
entity_types.definition: A property, value, or variable that defines or controls the behavior of a system, model, or process.

relation_types.label: PART_OF
relation_types.definition: One entity is a part of another (a part-whole structure).

relation_types.label: CREATES
relation_types.definition: One entity builds or produces another entity.

relation_types.label: STUDIES
relation_types.definition: One entity examines, analyzes, or studies another entity.

relation_types.label: CAUSES
relation_types.definition: One entity is explicitly the cause of another entity or phenomenon.

relation_types.label: RELATED_TO
relation_types.definition: A clear semantic relation between two entities that fits none of the other four types (residual type).
